description: The plot shows how the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” varies with sample size for two vision-language models evaluated on two benchmarks. The x-axis is labeled with sample sizes on a linear scale, spanning 128 to 1024 with tick marks at 128, 256, 512, and 1024. The y-axis is labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.5 with regularly spaced tick labels every 0.1. Four lines are shown: a blue solid line with circular markers (LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep) that rises from about 0.20 at 128 to about 0.25 at 256, about 0.35 at 512, and about 0.36 at 1024; an orange solid line with square markers (Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep) that increases from about 0.15 at 128 to about 0.23 at 256, about 0.42 at 512, and stays near 0.42 at 1024; a green solid line with upward-triangle markers (LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench) that goes from about 0.06 at 128 to about 0.21 at 256, about 0.37 at 512, and about 0.38 at 1024; and a red solid line with diamond markers (Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench) that moves from about 0.24 at 128 to about 0.26 at 256, about 0.43 at 512, and about 0.52 at 1024. A legend in the lower-right maps colors and marker shapes to the four series.
caption_used: The plot illustrates the 'Harmful with Refusal Ratio' across different sample sizes for two models on two benchmarks. The x-axis is labeled with sample sizes, presented on a linear scale with tick marks at values 128, 256, 512, and 1024. The y-axis represents the 'Harmful with Refusal Ratio,' also on a linear scale, with values ranging from 0.0 to 0.5 in increments of 0.1. The blue line, representing 'LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep,' starts at approximately 0.2 at 128, increases steadily to about 0.4 at 512, and remains constant through 1024. The orange line, 'Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep,' begins at around 0.15, rises sharply to approximately 0.45 at 512, and stabilizes at that level through 1024. The green line, 'LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench,' starts at approximately 0.08 and rises to nearly 0.4 by 512, remaining constant thereafter. The red line, 'Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench,' begins at 0.25, reaches approximately 0.45 at 512, and slightly increases to 0.5 at 1024. There is a legend available at the bottom right of the plot to map different line styles to their labels.
